persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an 8-second realistic widescreen video looking down at a person's hands folding a plain blue sheet of paper in half on a wooden table, then pressing the crease flat. Keep both hands and the whole sheet in view. One fixed shot, no sound.
bank.Source image: No photo; generate everything from text.
bank.Person and framing: Your call on the person's appearance. Show both hands and the whole sheet from above; no face is needed.
bank.Action and props: Fold one plain blue sheet of paper in half on a wooden table, then press the crease flat.
bank.Camera, text and audio: One fixed overhead shot, no text or sound.

messages.text: I'd like you to make a realistic video looking down at a person's hands with a plain blue sheet of paper on a wooden table. I'm asking because I find simple paper-folding motions oddly satisfying, even though I probably overthink how to describe them. The video should be 8 seconds long and widescreen. Have the person fold the sheet in half and then press the crease flat. Please keep both hands and the whole sheet in view throughout the video. It should all be one fixed shot, with no sound.
